next_tickets.title: S16r: join external DAQ runlog provenance to B-stack forced/random pedestal mirror
next_tickets.body: Question: can DAQ runlog, scaler, or converter metadata identify whether non-beam B-stack forced/random pedestal triggers were acquired outside the mounted ROOT mirror? Expected information gain: distinguishes a true acquisition gap from a mirror/metadata omission and would make the S16p adoption rule directly testable against no-pulse labels.

title: checksum-bound ingest of true forced-random B-stack pedestal ROOT labels
